name: Find a saga and recover from an empty search
description: Finds existing titles and recovers from a search with no results.
steps: Open The collection and select STARFALL.
Search for Begin and verify its saga is shown.
Open its edition notes and close the dialog with Escape.
Search for zzzz-no-such-toon and verify the empty result message.
Clear the search and choose All.
expected: Only matching sagas appear while filtered; the empty state is visible for the unknown title, and clearing restores all six sagas.

name: Save and remove a book from the shortlist
description: Checks a title can be retained across refresh and removed.
steps: Open Workspace, select Book library, choose Volcano Racers and search Ignition.
Save Ignition to shortlist; switch to My shortlist.
Reload and open My shortlist again.
Remove Ignition, then reload and reopen My shortlist.
expected: Ignition is saved after the first reload and absent after removal and the second reload.

name: Track and reset a world reading path on mobile
description: Verifies reading marks persist and a reset is scoped to one world.
steps: Scroll to the reading path guide and choose Volcano Racers.
Mark Ignition read and open its Edition notes; dismiss the dialog.
Choose STARFALL and mark Begin read.
Reload, return to STARFALL, and verify Begin remains marked.
Reset STARFALL reading marks and switch back to Volcano Racers.
expected: STARFALL marks clear while Ignition remains marked for Volcano Racers; guide controls and notes are usable on mobile.

name: Explore both worlds and enlarge the cover artwork
description: Checks both cover images and world dossiers remain accessible on the new host.
steps: Switch the hero spotlight to STARFALL and follow Explore STARFALL.
Find the world atlas, select STARFALL and inspect its dossier.
Select Volcano Racers and inspect its different dossier.
Open each Gallery cover and close the enlarged artwork dialog.
expected: Spotlight and dossier contents change to the selected world, both covers load visibly, and enlarged artwork dialogs dismiss correctly.

name: Read development boundaries and studio information
covers: blocked purchase and app launch boundaries
description: Checks the hosted studio accurately presents development status and informational links.
steps: Open Workspace and switch to the app connections tab, then Production.
Verify app launch is described as unavailable and checkout is disabled.
Navigate to In development and verify drafts are described as private with public release pending.
Scroll through The studio and expand FAQ entries about finished books and animated episodes.
expected: Development availability is clearly labelled, FAQs expand, and private source links, paid checkout and unavailable app launches are absent.
